stock.description: Pengo Holdings Group Ltd. operates as a specialist contractor, primarily focusing on building infrastructural pipelines and delivering associated engineering services. The firm predominantly caters to the gas, water supply, telecommunications, and power sectors. Established in Singapore on July 17, 2018, the company was founded by Guan Wah Shi and Guan Lee Shi.
